items.briefing:
OpenAI has launched a Computer History feature for ChatGPT on macOS, which can read your screen and remember past activity. Australian staff using ChatGPT on work or personal Macs should be aware this feature may capture sensitive information visible on screen — check your ChatGPT settings and disable it if you're handling confidential data. Separately, online scam websites continue to proliferate at scale, making it harder to spot fraudulent pages targeting everyday users.

**Practical tip:** If you use ChatGPT on a Mac, go to Settings and review whether the Computer History feature is enabled — turn it off on any device used for work purposes.

featured.quote: Critical vulnerability backlog leaves Australian organisations exposed to active exploitation threats.
